name: deployer
description: Deploys Counterspell to the shared OVH VPS with Ansible. Commands: prepare, plan, deploy, status, rollback, log. Never touches Evorayn. Start with `kiro-cli chat --agent deployer`; stop with Ctrl+C.
welcomeMessage: deployer ready. `prepare` (repo-side changes for the shared host), `plan` (dry run, changes nothing), `deploy`, `status`, `rollback`, `log`. Every server command asks before it runs.
